correct_recommendations: Replace the denylist with an allowlist: plugin_env builds the plugin environment from named variables only, including PATH, HOME, HTTPS_PROXY and the TINKERBOX_ variables.
invalid_options: Add STRIPE_API_KEY and SENTRY_DSN to DENYLIST.
A pattern-based denylist on names such as *_KEY or *_SECRET.
Only remove the environment dump from feed-fetch debug output.
An allowlist limited to TINKERBOX_ variables as the contract document states.
root_cause: plugin_env copies the whole runner environment with dict(os.environ) and removes only DENYLIST, so every new variable in deploy/runner.env reaches every plugin by default.

dependent_facts.true_value: plugin_env starts from dict(os.environ) and pops DENYLIST names
feed-fetch prints dict(os.environ) to stderr when debug is set; a customer pasted it into a public ticket
BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET is also in the runner environment and not denied
HOME, and PATH to run qpdf
claims plugins read only TINKERBOX_ variables, which the plugin code contradicts

required_questions.question: Why does the plugin see STRIPE_API_KEY at all?
required_questions.expected_answer: plugin_env copies the full runner environment.

required_questions.question: Why not just extend the denylist?
required_questions.expected_answer: Every future secret leaks until someone adds it; BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET already leaks.

required_questions.question: Which variables must the allowlist keep?
required_questions.expected_answer: PATH, HOME, HTTPS_PROXY, TINKERBOX_ variables; found in the plugin code.

required_questions.question: What can break?
required_questions.expected_answer: A plugin that reads a variable outside the allowlist.

valid_alternatives.option: Per-plugin declared environment: each plugin lists the variables it needs and the runner passes only those
valid_alternatives.trade_off: Tighter per plugin, but needs a manifest format and a change to every plugin.
valid_alternatives.primary_when: Plugins come from third parties or need different variables.

closing_decision: One decision: approve the allowlist with its variable list, or decide a single follow-up such as removing the feed-fetch env dump.

understanding.problem: A plugin leaked STRIPE_API_KEY because plugins inherit the full runner environment.
understanding.breaks: Any new secret reaches every plugin; feed-fetch debug output exposes the environment.
understanding.fix: Build the plugin environment from an allowlist of named variables.
understanding.cost: A plugin that needs a new variable needs an allowlist edit; small code change in plugin_env.
